svg.aria-label: Four cards. Voice: one line of notes over time. Vertical interval: the distance between two notes sounding together; example C4 + E4, a major third of 4 semitones. Voice leading: how each voice moves from one pair to the next. Counterpoint: two or more independent lines sounding together.
svg.title: Four words: voice, vertical interval, voice leading, counterpoint

g.text: One line of notes over time.

How to read this graphic: Each card gives the
word, its meaning in one sentence, and a tiny
picture built from the same marks as the rest
of Week 2. The vertical interval card carries
the only colour: C4 + E4, the major third
